structured.answer: I'd take the second one: under each fund it says in plain Hebrew what's inside, like "מאה עשרים וחמש החברות... בבורסה בתל אביב". In the first one I saw only "ת"א-125" and English letters, and I can't tell what those are. I'm not putting money into either before I ask you or the bank.
